# IMPERIA COLD WAR - European Communities 1970 (record of the Council: entries at vote close, RECORD tab, in force).
# Generated by Claude outputs/COLDWAR_EC_generator/build.py - do not edit by hand.

# Any scope, at the close of a vote (context of the file and its tally). Files it in the record; keeps the newest 24.
COLDWAR_EC_record_add = {
	add_to_array = { array = global.cwec_rec_it value = global.cwec_ctx_item }
	add_to_array = { array = global.cwec_rec_res value = global.cwec_ctx_res }
	add_to_array = { array = global.cwec_rec_day value = global.num_days }
	add_to_array = { array = global.cwec_rec_by value = global.cwec_ctx_by }
	add_to_array = { array = global.cwec_rec_tg value = global.cwec_ctx_target }
	add_to_array = { array = global.cwec_rec_iss value = global.cwec_ctx_issue }
	add_to_array = { array = global.cwec_rec_wf value = global.cwec_last_wf }
	add_to_array = { array = global.cwec_rec_wa value = global.cwec_last_wa }
	add_to_array = { array = global.cwec_rec_w value = global.cwec_last_w }
	add_to_array = { array = global.cwec_rec_sf value = global.cwec_last_sf }
	add_to_array = { array = global.cwec_rec_sa value = global.cwec_last_sa }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_rec_it^num > 24 } }
		remove_from_array = { array = global.cwec_rec_it index = 0 }
		remove_from_array = { array = global.cwec_rec_res index = 0 }
		remove_from_array = { array = global.cwec_rec_day index = 0 }
		remove_from_array = { array = global.cwec_rec_by index = 0 }
		remove_from_array = { array = global.cwec_rec_tg index = 0 }
		remove_from_array = { array = global.cwec_rec_iss index = 0 }
		remove_from_array = { array = global.cwec_rec_wf index = 0 }
		remove_from_array = { array = global.cwec_rec_wa index = 0 }
		remove_from_array = { array = global.cwec_rec_w index = 0 }
		remove_from_array = { array = global.cwec_rec_sf index = 0 }
		remove_from_array = { array = global.cwec_rec_sa index = 0 }
	}
}
